comparison.objective: Seat a casting ring leaving 5–8 mm above a wax crown without touching the wax; candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Clearance-controlled ring placement around a fragile crown versus coaxial insertion of a narrow mandrel, bimanual impact regulation, withdrawal, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Ring seated with 5–8 mm projection and zero wax contact versus four safe notch fractures, retained inserts, and all tangs in containment.
comparison.reason: Both protect a nearby fragile feature, but one tests clearance-preserving seating and the other controlled fracture plus fragment handling. No spec versions or additional seating/contact tolerances are available.
